items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I told the Doc, I went down to see him.

ctx.x: he made a mistake, and the funniest thing is I told you yesterday, that Doc Cheatham, came over, three days before World War II was declared.
Doc Cheatham came over, passing France for through Holland to join Freddy, you see.
Well, just to follow that out a little bit, Freddy went back during the war, I mean right before the war.
